product_brief: Postfix is a mail transfer agent (MTA) that provides stable release 3.10.0 with updated TLS support and delivery agent protocol changes.
pqc_capability_description: Postfix 3.10.0 includes forward compatibility support for OpenSSL 3.5 post-quantum cryptography. It allows `tls_eecdh_auto_curves` and `tls_ffdhe_auto_groups` parameters to be set to empty values, enabling algorithm selection to be managed through OpenSSL configuration.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Requires "postfix reload" or restart after upgrade due to internal protocol change in the delivery agent.

product_brief: Email encryption service offering post-quantum protection for personal and business communications.
pqc_capability_description: Post-quantum protection is available on all plans, including free. It generates and uses post-quantum-ready keys for new encrypted emails. Support includes OpenPGP v6. Older emails are planned to be re-encrypted in the future.
key_management_model: Users can generate, mark obsolete, or mark compromised PQC keys similar to RSA or ECC keys.
pqc_roadmap_details: Gradual rollout; plan to re-encrypt older emails in the future; adding support for OpenPGP v6; standardizing with projects such as Thunderbird.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Gradual rollout; users enable via account settings; backward compatibility implied for existing keys.
financial_&_business_impact: Available on all plans including free.

product_brief: OpenPGP implementation library and CLI tool with post-quantum cryptography support via hybrid algorithms.
pqc_capability_description: Implemented in pre-releases (sq 1.4.0-pqc.1, sequoia-openpgp 2.2.0-pqc.1) using OpenSSL backend. Supports hybrid PQC schemes: ML-DSA-65+Ed25519, ML-DSA-87+Ed448, SLH-DSA variants, ML-KEM-768+X25519, ML-KEM-1024+X448. Official release expected after IETF ratification (H1 2026).
crypto_primitives: ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87, SLH-DSA-128s, SLH-DSA-128f, SLH-DSA-256s, ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024, Ed25519, Ed448, X25519, X448, RSA, AES-256/OCB
key_management_model: Programmatic key generation via CLI (`sq`) and Rust API (`sequoia-openpgp`); supports password-protected secret keys; uses RFC 9580 certificate format for PQC keys.
